title: A CI executor on a stock GitLab runner refuses every job, since the clone's origin url carries the job token and never equals the submitter's url, and a url with a credential reaches the job record
goal: kj_store.remote_url returns the integration remote's url without any user or password part (https://host/path from https://user:token@host/path), for the submitter's job record and for the executor's comparison alike, so Sync.fits matches a runner clone whose origin carries gitlab-ci-token and no credential enters a job record, an event or a server's git clone argument

run: import sys,subprocess,tempfile; sys.path.insert(0,'_tools'); import kj_store; d=tempfile.mkdtemp(); subprocess.run(['git','init','-q',d],check=True); subprocess.run(['git','-C',d,'remote','add','origin','https://gitlab-ci-token:TOK@host.example.org/g/p.git'],check=True); u=kj_store.remote_url(d); assert u=='https://host.example.org/g/p.git', u

gates.question: Which url forms lose their user part, and where else is the credential cut besides kj_store.remote_url?
options: Cut the user and password of any scheme:// url in kj_store.bare_url, applied to remote_url, to --clone-url and to the server executor's clone argument and clone directory name; leave scp-like user@host:path as it is
